writingStandard.voice: simple, conversational, purposeful, age-appropriate, and learner-first

strands.title: Addition And Subtraction In Daily Life

learningOutcomes.text: solve and explain problems about whole numbers and place value

inquiryQuestions: How can whole numbers and place value help you solve a real problem?
prerequisites: Recall one school, home, or community example connected to Whole Numbers And Place Value.
Review key vocabulary from the previous Hisabati lesson.
misconceptions: giving a general answer about Whole Numbers And Place Value without a clear example, method, or evidence
topics.localContext: a Tanzania school, market, farming, building, transport, or data problem for Whole Numbers And Place Value
explanationSequence: Start with a concrete country or local situation.
Name the important idea in learner-friendly words.
Model one example slowly.
Guide the learner through a similar task.
Ask the learner to apply the idea independently.
successCriteria: working is shown step by step
